head.t: Hologic wins direct-award mammography maintenance renewal at Somerset NHS Foundation Trust
head.x: Somerset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded Hologic a maintenance contract worth £187,901.38 to cover 12 Hologic mammography devices at Musgrove Park Hospital and off-site locations, running from May 2027 to March 2028.
